name: harness-audit

plugins.name: harness-audit
plugins.description: Audit any repo's agent harness against four pillars (harness-in-code, role separation, automatic verification, loop design) and emit an executable rubric a loop can converge against, plus the independent-verifier protocol and the model line-up resolver that keeps reviewer and implementer in different families.

plugins.name: harness-loops
plugins.description: The loops that build against a harness rubric: /orchestrate, /review-loop, /iterate and /skill-loop, the critic, scorer, optimizer and skill-improver agents, the loop-gate that checks every seat's output, the Pi develop-phase runner, and the optional TypeSafe Jev classifier (round-to-round finding dedupe and a per-prompt skill/model-tier router; off without a TYPESAFE_API_KEY).

plugins.name: harness-guards
plugins.description: Protect and observe any Claude Code session: write-time guards (destructive-command gate, secret scan, --no-verify block), a repeat-tool loop-hygiene reminder, loop telemetry, and /dashboard-harness and /session-review, a zero-token auditor read from the local transcripts that never leaves the machine.

description: Three plugins for coding agents: diagnose a harness (harness-audit), build against it (harness-loops), protect and observe every session (harness-guards). Each installs alone.
